split_policy: fixed once over all 3109 qualified samples; target masks do not redefine splits

N_EF_states_per_eV_atom.definition: total DOS at the static Fermi energy per atom

fermi_crossing_count.definition: spin-resolved bands with a segment-local crossing of the static Fermi energy

fermi_crossing_event_count.definition: deduplicated adjacent-point crossing events within line-path segments

fermi_crossing_slope_eV_A.definition: median absolute dE/dk over deduplicated static-Fermi crossing events

dos_curve_E_minus_EF_states_per_eV_atom.definition: DOS on the common E-E_F grid from -10 to 10 eV

near_fermi_band_energies_E_minus_EF_eV.definition: 16 near-Fermi spin-resolved bands resampled separately over line-path segments
